annotations.text:
Annabel's Pet Care — business card
3.5 x 2in trim (336 x 192px at 96ppi).

Front is direction C, back is direction A. The 4px rose rule
was carried from the front onto the back's left edge so the
two read as one card — the only change to either.

Before printing:
• [QR] is a reserved box, not a real code. Generate it from the
  Google review short link once the profile is verified.
• No "Insured" line yet — add at reprint once PSA is bound.
• Add the Park City address if the printer needs it for GMB proof.
• Ask the printer for 0.125in bleed; keep type 0.125in off the trim.

Not chosen — kept for reference. Prices were removed from
B's back on 2026-09-15; cards point to the site instead.
